title: Measures to Identify and Help Women with Ante- and Postnatal Depression
what_it_is: Measures to Identify and Help Women with Ante- and Postnatal Depression

sections.label: Postnatal depression screening funding
sections.summary: Since 2007, KKH and NUH have been funded under the National Mental Health Blueprint to screen and intervene early for postnatal depression.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Since 2007, KKH and NUH have been funded under the National Mental Health Blueprint to provide screening and early intervention for postnatal depression.

sections.label: Screening and psychiatrist referrals
sections.summary: Since 2007, both programmes screened around 80,050 women, and 818 women were referred to and seen by psychiatrists for follow-up.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Since 2007, both programmes have screened around 80,050 women; and 818 women were subsequently referred to and seen by psychiatrists for further follow-up.

sections.label: MOH depression clinical practice guideline
sections.summary: MOH developed a clinical practice guideline on depression in 2010, available to all practitioners in private and public hospitals.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regard to the first question, MOH, in 2010 developed a clinical practice guideline on depression, which is available to all practitioners, both in the private and public hospitals.

sections.label: HPB and KKH pregnancy module
sections.summary: HPB recently worked with KKH to have a module in the Health Hub Track called Healthy Pregnancy Plan.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In addition to that, HPB, for instance, recently worked with KKH to have a module in the Health Hub Track called Healthy Pregnancy Plan.
